name: Corn wine
summary: Rượu ngô is the northern kitchen’s best-known drink: steamed corn mixed with a yeast cake of more than 20 forest leaves, rested about a month, then distilled.
howToEat: Take a small cup with an evening village meal. A modest pour is counted as a restorative.
seoTitle: Cao Bang corn wine — leaf yeast
seoDescription: Rượu ngô is the northern kitchen’s best-known drink: steamed corn mixed with a yeast cake of more than 20 forest leaves, rested about a month, then distilled.
